use.flag: Enable debugging (including logging of input of RIME input methods)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: RIME (Rime Input Method Engine) is the core library of the Rime input method. It provides the dictionary, input engine and plugin interfaces used by its Fcitx and IBus frontends.
RIME（Rime Input Method Engine）是 Rime 输入法的核心库，提供词典、 输入引擎和插件接口，供 Fcitx 与 IBus 前端使用。
